seytanKurbanTirasAdimlar.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
seytanKurbanTirasAdimlar.step1: 1. Step: Throw 7 pebbles at the Large Jamrah (the talbiyah ends with the first throw)
seytanKurbanTirasAdimlar.step2: 2. Step: Slaughter the sacrifice yourself or have it slaughtered for you
seytanKurbanTirasAdimlar.step3: 3. Step: Shave the head or shorten the hair — first taḥallul (partial release)
seytanKurbanTirasAdimlar.step4: 4. Step: Go to Makkah for the Tawāf of Visit (Ziyārah)
seytanKurbanTirasAdimlar.step5: 5. Step: Make 7 rounds of ṭawāf around the Kaʿbah → second taḥallūl
seytanKurbanTirasAdimlar.step6: 6. Step: Perform 2 rakʿah of the ṭawāf prayer
seytanKurbanTirasAdimlar.step9: 9. Step: Return to Minā and stay the night
seytanKurbanTirasAdimlar.day2Step1: 1. Step: Throw 7 pebbles at the Small Jamrah → then supplicate
seytanKurbanTirasAdimlar.day2Step2: 2. Step: Throw 7 pebbles at the Middle Jamrah → then supplicate
seytanKurbanTirasAdimlar.day2Step3: 3. Step: Throw 7 pebbles at the Large Jamrah → leave without supplicating (do not stand to supplicate after)
seytanKurbanTirasAdimlar.day3Step1: 1. Step: Throw 7 pebbles at the Small Jamrah → then supplicate
seytanKurbanTirasAdimlar.day3Step2: 2. Step: Throw 7 pebbles at the Middle Jamrah → then supplicate
seytanKurbanTirasAdimlar.day3Step3: 3. Step: Throw 7 pebbles at the Large Jamrah → leave without supplicating
seytanKurbanTirasAdimlar.day3Step4: 4. Step: First departure (nafar al-awwal) → those in a hurry may leave Minā before sunset
seytanKurbanTirasAdimlar.day3Step5: 5. Step: Second departure (nafar al-thānī) → those not in a hurry also stone on 13 Dhū al-Ḥijjah, then leave

seytanKurbanTirasAdim1.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
seytanKurbanTirasAdim1.tasAtarkenLabel: To be said with each pebble:
seytanKurbanTirasAdim1.tasAtarkenMeaning: In the name of Allah, Allah is the Greatest.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim1.telbiyeSonBody: The talbiyah is ended when you throw the first pebble; it is not recited after that.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim1.taslama1: 🪨 The seven pebbles are thrown one by one
seytanKurbanTirasAdim1.taslama2: ✋ Each pebble is thrown with the right hand
seytanKurbanTirasAdim1.taslama3: 📏 The pebble should hit the pillar; if it falls into the surrounding pool, that counts
seytanKurbanTirasAdim1.taslama4: 🚶 After each throw, do not stop to make duʿāʾ; move on promptly
seytanKurbanTirasAdim1.note1: ⏰ It is done after sunrise, not before the sun has risen.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim1.note2: 📍 On this day only the Large Jamrah (al-ʿAqabah) is stoned, not the others.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim1.note3: 👩 Women and those who are frail may choose a quieter time to avoid the worst crowds.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim1.note4: ⚠️ Avoid harming or pushing others; haste and roughness are out of place.

seytanKurbanTirasAdim2.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
seytanKurbanTirasAdim2.niyet: O Allah! I intend to offer the sacrificial animal for the sake of Your good pleasure; accept it from me.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim2.kesimDua: Bismillāhi Allāhu Akbar, Allāhumma minka wa laka
seytanKurbanTirasAdim2.kesimMeaning: In the name of Allah, Allah is the Greatest. O Allah! This is from You and to You alone.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim2.note1: 📅 It is done on the first day of ʿĪd, after the stoning at the Large Jamrah.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim2.note2: 🐑 For Ḥajj al-tamattuʿ and Ḥajj al-qirān, the sacrifice is obligatory (wājib).
seytanKurbanTirasAdim2.note3: 🐑 For Ḥajj al-ifrād it is not obligatory; an optional (nafl) sacrifice may still be made.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim2.note4: 📍 It is sunnah to slaughter in Minā, but it may be done in Makkah as well.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim2.note5: ✂️ Shaving (or cutting the hair) comes after the sacrifice; the order is important.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim2.note6: 🤲 When slaughtering or when it is slaughtered for you, remember Ibrāhīm (ʿalayhi as-salām) and his son.

seytanKurbanTirasAdim3.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
seytanKurbanTirasAdim3.duaMeaning: O Allah! Forgive those who shave their heads and those who shorten their hair.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim3.erkek1: ✂️ Shaving the entire head is more virtuous (afḍal)
seytanKurbanTirasAdim3.erkek2: ✂️ Shortening the hair is also sufficient (at least about “four finger-widths”)
seytanKurbanTirasAdim3.kadin1: ✂️ A small lock of hair is cut (about 2–3 cm)
seytanKurbanTirasAdim3.kadin2: ❌ The whole head is not shaved
seytanKurbanTirasAdim3.tahallul5: ❌ Spousal relations remain forbidden until the Tawāf of Visit (ziyārah)
seytanKurbanTirasAdim3.note1: 🎉 You are leaving the state of iḥrām; you can change into your normal clothes.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim3.note2: 📅 It is done after the sacrifice has been offered.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim3.note3: ⏰ The remaining prohibitions are lifted in full only after the Tawāf of Visit.

seytanKurbanTirasAdim4.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
seytanKurbanTirasAdim4.onemBody: 🕌 The Tawāf of Visit is an obligatory (farḍ) pillar of Ḥajj; if it is omitted, the Ḥajj is not valid.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim4.note1: 📅 It is preferably done on the first day of ʿĪd; the second or third day is also possible.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim4.note2: ⚠️ If it is not completed before sunset on the third day, a due sacrificial expiation (dam) is required.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim4.note3: 🚶 After shaving or cutting the hair, one travels to Makkah in ordinary (non-iḥrām) clothing.

seytanKurbanTirasAdim5.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
seytanKurbanTirasAdim5.niyet: O Allah! I intend to perform the Tawāf of Visit for the sake of Your good pleasure; accept it from me.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim5.herTurDuaLabel: To be recited on each round:
seytanKurbanTirasAdim5.herTurDua: Sūbḥān Allāh wa al-ḥamdu lillāh wa lā ilāha illā Allāh wa Allāhu akbar
seytanKurbanTirasAdim5.ikinciTahallulBody: After the Tawāf of Visit is completed, all the restrictions of iḥrām are lifted.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim5.serbest2: ✅ All iḥrām-related restrictions are fully removed
seytanKurbanTirasAdim5.note1: 🔄 Keep the Kaʿbah to your left and walk against the direction of a clock (counterclockwise).
seytanKurbanTirasAdim5.note2: 🔢 7 rounds = one ṭawāf; you begin at the Black Stone (Ḥajar al-Aswad).
seytanKurbanTirasAdim5.note3: 🕌 After the ṭawāf, perform 2 rakʿah of prayer (ṭawāf prayer).
seytanKurbanTirasAdim5.note4: 🎉 You have now left iḥrām in the full sense — congratulations! 🤲

seytanKurbanTirasAdim6.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
seytanKurbanTirasAdim6.duaArap: Allāhumma taqabbal minnā innaka anta as-samīʿu al-ʿalīm
seytanKurbanTirasAdim6.duaMeaning: O Allah! Accept it from us; You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim6.note1: 📍 Preferably behind Maqām Ibrāhīm when possible.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim6.note2: 👥 If crowded, it may be performed anywhere in al-Masjid al-Ḥarām.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim6.note3: ⏰ It is not performed in the disliked (karāhah) times.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim6.note4: 🤲 After the prayer, one turns to the Kaʿbah and makes abundant supplication.

seytanKurbanTirasAdim7.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
seytanKurbanTirasAdim7.icerkenDuaArap: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka ʿilman nāfiʿan wa rizqan wāsiʿan wa shifāʾan min kulli dāʾin wa suqmin bi-raḥmatika yā arḥama r-raḥimīn
seytanKurbanTirasAdim7.icerkenDuaMeaning: O Allah! I ask You, by Your mercy, for beneficial knowledge, abundant provision, and healing from every illness and ailment — O Most Merciful of those who show mercy.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim7.note1: 🕋 Face the Kaʿbah and drink standing.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim7.note2: 💧 Drink plentifully, but do not waste.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim7.note3: 🤲 After drinking, make personal supplication; this moment is very precious.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim7.note4: ✨ Zamzam is said to bring healing in line with the intention with which it is drunk.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim7.note5: 🎉 The Tawāf of Visit is complete — congratulations! Time to return to Minā.

seytanKurbanTirasAdim8.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
seytanKurbanTirasAdim8.whoTemettu: 🔵 Tamattuʿ: Saʿy was already done in ʿumrah, so you do not do it here.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim8.whoKiran: 🟡 Qirān: If saʿy was done after the arrival ṭawāf, you do not do it here.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim8.whoIfrad: 🔴 Ifrād: If saʿy was not done after the arrival ṭawāf, you do it here.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim8.niyet: O Allah! I intend to perform the saʿy of ḥajj for Your pleasure, so accept it from me.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim8.note1: 📍 Saʿy starts at al-Ṣafā and ends at al-Marwah.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim8.note2: 🔢 A total of 7 shawṭ (laps) is completed.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim8.note3: 🏃 Men may hurry (ramal) where the path is marked in green for men only.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim8.note4: 👩 Women walk at a normal pace and do not hurry between the markers.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim8.note5: ⚠️ This step varies with the type of ḥajj; if unsure, ask your guide.

seytanKurbanTirasAdim9.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
seytanKurbanTirasAdim9.duaArap: Allāhumma taqabbal minnā wa-ghfir lanā war-ḥamnā innaka anta t-tawwāb ar-raḥīm
seytanKurbanTirasAdim9.duaMeaning: O Allah! Accept from us, forgive us, and have mercy on us. You are indeed the Oft-Returning, the All-Merciful.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim9.note1: 📍 It is obligatory to stay overnight within the boundaries of Minā; you should not stay outside them.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim9.note2: 🌙 Today was very full — get some rest.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim9.note3: 📅 Tomorrow is Day 2 — after al-zuhr, stoning the three jamarāt (in order).
seytanKurbanTirasAdim9.note4: 🤲 Before sleep, give thanks to Allah for today.
seytanKurbanTirasAdim9.note5: 🎉 The greatest day of ḥajj is complete — al-ḥamdu lillāh! 🕌

seytanKurbanTirasGun2Adim1.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
seytanKurbanTirasGun2Adim1.tasMeaning: In the name of Allah, Allah is the Greatest.
seytanKurbanTirasGun2Adim1.yediTasDuaMeaning: O Allah! Forgive me and all believing men and women.
seytanKurbanTirasGun2Adim1.note1: ⏰ It is done after the time of the sun at its zenith (after ẓuhr); not valid before that.
seytanKurbanTirasGun2Adim1.note2: 📍 The Small Jamrah is the first of the three, closest to Minā.
seytanKurbanTirasGun2Adim1.note3: 🪨 The seven are thrown one by one, each with a takbīr.
seytanKurbanTirasGun2Adim1.note4: 🤲 After stoning, one stands facing the Kaʿbah and supplicates at length.
seytanKurbanTirasGun2Adim1.note5: ➡️ Then go on to the Middle Jamrah.

seytanKurbanTirasGun2Adim2.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
seytanKurbanTirasGun2Adim2.tasMeaning: In the name of Allah, Allah is the Greatest.
seytanKurbanTirasGun2Adim2.yediTasDua: Rabbanā ātinā fi'd-dunyā ḥasanah wa fil-ākhirati ḥasanah wa qinā 'adhāb an-nār
seytanKurbanTirasGun2Adim2.yediTasDuaMeaning: Our Lord! Give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.
seytanKurbanTirasGun2Adim2.note1: ⏰ It is done after the sun has passed the zenith; the order of the jamarāt is essential.
seytanKurbanTirasGun2Adim2.note2: 📍 The Middle Jamrah is the one in the centre among the three.
seytanKurbanTirasGun2Adim2.note3: 🪨 The seven are thrown one by one, each with a takbīr.
seytanKurbanTirasGun2Adim2.note4: 🤲 After stoning, one stands facing the Kaʿbah and supplicates at length.
seytanKurbanTirasGun2Adim2.note5: ➡️ Then go on to the Large Jamrah: there one does not stand to supplicate (after the throws).

seytanKurbanTirasGun2Adim3.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
seytanKurbanTirasGun2Adim3.tasMeaning: In the name of Allah, Allah is the Greatest.
seytanKurbanTirasGun2Adim3.onemliBody: At the Large Jamrah, you do not supplicate after the stoning; you leave straight away.
seytanKurbanTirasGun2Adim3.note1: ⏰ It is done after the sun has passed the zenith; the order of the jamarāt is essential.
seytanKurbanTirasGun2Adim3.note2: 📍 The Large Jamrah is the last of the three, closest to Makkah.
seytanKurbanTirasGun2Adim3.note3: 🪨 The seven are thrown one by one, each with a takbīr.
seytanKurbanTirasGun2Adim3.note4: ❓ Why no supplication? The sunnah is to move on, as the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) did not stand here to supplicate.
seytanKurbanTirasGun2Adim3.note5: ✅ Day 2 stoning is complete — return to Minā to stay the night.

seytanKurbanTirasGun3Adim3.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
seytanKurbanTirasGun3Adim3.tasMeaning: In the name of Allah, Allah is the Greatest.
seytanKurbanTirasGun3Adim3.onemliBody: At the Large Jamrah, you do not supplicate after the stoning; you leave straight away.
seytanKurbanTirasGun3Adim3.note1: ⏰ It is done after the sun has passed the zenith; the order of the jamarāt is essential.
seytanKurbanTirasGun3Adim3.note2: 📍 The Large Jamrah is the last of the three, closest to Makkah.
seytanKurbanTirasGun3Adim3.note3: 🪨 The seven are thrown one by one, each with a takbīr.
seytanKurbanTirasGun3Adim3.note4: ❓ Why no supplication? The sunnah is to move on, as the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) did not stand here to supplicate.

seytanKurbanTirasGun3Adim4.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
seytanKurbanTirasGun3Adim4.duaArap: Allāhumma lā tajʿal hādhā ākhir al-ʿahdi min baytika al-ḥarām
seytanKurbanTirasGun3Adim4.duaMeaning: O Allah! Do not make this the last of my visits to Your Sacred House.
seytanKurbanTirasGun3Adim4.nefrBody: On 12 Dhū al-Ḥijjah, after finishing the stoning, it is permissible to leave Minā before sunset. This is called al-nafar al-awwal (early departure).
seytanKurbanTirasGun3Adim4.note1: ⏰ One should leave Minā before sunset.
seytanKurbanTirasGun3Adim4.note2: ⚠️ If you stay in Minā until the sun has set, you must complete the Day 3 stoning and then depart.
seytanKurbanTirasGun3Adim4.note3: ✅ The Qurʾān points to this concession (al-Baqarah, 203).
seytanKurbanTirasGun3Adim4.note4: 🕌 Before leaving Minā, do not forget the Farewell Ṭawāf!
seytanKurbanTirasGun3Adim4.note5: 🤲 When bidding farewell to Minā, supplicate, and remember these blessed days with goodness.

seytanKurbanTirasGun3Adim5.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
seytanKurbanTirasGun3Adim5.duaArap: Allāhumma lā tajʿal hādhā ākhir al-ʿahdi min baytika al-ḥarām wa min hādhā al-makān al-mubārak
seytanKurbanTirasGun3Adim5.duaMeaning: O Allah! Do not make this the last of my visit to Your Sacred House and to this blessed place.
seytanKurbanTirasGun3Adim5.nefrBody: On 13 Dhū al-Ḥijjah, stoning the Small, Middle, and Large jamarāt (7 pebbles each), then leaving. This is al-nafar al-thānī (later departure). It is the more virtuous option.
seytanKurbanTirasGun3Adim5.sira3: 3️⃣ Large Jamrah → 7 pebbles → leave without supplicating
seytanKurbanTirasGun3Adim5.note1: ⏰ It is done after the time of the sun at its zenith.
seytanKurbanTirasGun3Adim5.note2: ⭐ The Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) left by al-nafar al-thānī; it is more virtuous.
seytanKurbanTirasGun3Adim5.note3: 🕌 Before leaving Minā, do not forget the Farewell Ṭawāf!
seytanKurbanTirasGun3Adim5.note4: 🤲 Bid a final farewell to Minā, and remember these days with goodness.

seytanKurbanTirasGun2Adim4.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
seytanKurbanTirasGun2Adim4.duaArap: Allāhumma bika amsaynā wa bika aṣbaḥnā wa bika naḥyā wa bika namūtu wa ilayka al-maṣīr
seytanKurbanTirasGun2Adim4.duaMeaning: O Allah! Through You we enter the night and the morning; in You we live and die; to You is the return.
seytanKurbanTirasGun2Adim4.note1: 📍 It is obligatory to stay overnight within the boundaries of Minā.
seytanKurbanTirasGun2Adim4.note2: ⚠️ Staying outside Minā overnight without a valid excuse requires a penalty sacrifice.
seytanKurbanTirasGun2Adim4.note3: 🤲 Spend the night in dhikr and supplication.
seytanKurbanTirasGun2Adim4.note4: 😴 Rest — on Day 3 the stoning is repeated again.
seytanKurbanTirasGun2Adim4.note5: 📅 After al-zuhr tomorrow, 7 pebbles at each of the 3 jamarāt (in order).

vedaTavafAdimlar.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
vedaTavafAdimlar.step1: 1. Step: Make 7 final rounds of ṭawāf around the Kaʿbah (farewell ṭawāf)
vedaTavafAdimlar.step2: 2. Step: Perform 2 rakʿah of prayer (ṭawāf prayer)
vedaTavafAdimlar.step3: 3. Step: Drink Zamzam (for the last time here)

vedaTavafAdim1.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
vedaTavafAdim1.niyet: O Allah! I intend to perform the farewell ṭawāf for Your pleasure, so accept it from me.
vedaTavafAdim1.herTurDua: Subḥān Allāhi wa-l-ḥamdu lillāhi wa lā ilāha illā Allāhu wa Allāhu akbar
vedaTavafAdim1.vedaDuaArap: Allāhumma lā tajʿal hādhā ākhir al-ʿahdi min baytika al-ḥarām
vedaTavafAdim1.vedaDuaMeaning: O Allah! Do not make this the last of my visit to the Sacred House.
vedaTavafAdim1.note1: 🕋 The Kaʿbah is kept to the left; 7 shawṭ (rounds) counterclockwise.
vedaTavafAdim1.note2: 🤲 In each round, supplicate to Allah with sincerity, facing the Holy House.
vedaTavafAdim1.note3: 😢 This last ṭawāf is the most moving moment. Do not hold back your tears.
vedaTavafAdim1.note4: 👩 Women in menses are excused from the farewell ṭawāf; no expiation is due.
vedaTavafAdim1.note5: ⚠️ Leaving Makkah without the farewell ṭawāf requires a penalty sacrifice.

vedaTavafAdim2.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
vedaTavafAdim2.namazdaOkunacaklar: To be recited in the prayer:
vedaTavafAdim2.duaArap: Allāhumma taqabbal minnā innaka anta s-samīʿu l-ʿalīm
vedaTavafAdim2.duaMeaning: O Allah! Accept from us; You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
vedaTavafAdim2.note1: 📍 It is best behind Maqām Ibrāhīm, if possible.
vedaTavafAdim2.note2: 👥 In crowds, the prayer may be performed anywhere in al-Masjid al-Ḥarām.
vedaTavafAdim2.note3: ⏰ It is not performed in the disliked (makrūh) times.
vedaTavafAdim2.note4: 🤲 This may be the last ṣalāh in al-Masjid al-Ḥarām — perform it with sincerity.
vedaTavafAdim2.note5: 😢 After the prayer, stand toward the Kaʿbah, supplicate often, and take your leave.

vedaTavafAdim3.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
vedaTavafAdim3.duaArap: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka ʿilman nāfiʿan wa rizqan wāsiʿan wa shifāʾan min kulli dāʾin wa saqāmin bi-raḥmatika yā arḥama r-raḥimīn
vedaTavafAdim3.duaMeaning: O Allah! I ask You for beneficial knowledge, ample provision, and healing from every illness and pain, by Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful.
vedaTavafAdim3.note2: 💧 Drink abundantly, one last time; you will miss this water.
vedaTavafAdim3.note3: 🤲 Make personal supplication while drinking; this moment is precious.
vedaTavafAdim3.note4: ✨ Zamzam is healing for the intention for which it is drunk.
vedaTavafAdim3.note5: 😢 You are drinking this blessed water for the last time — be grateful and supplicate.

vedaTavafAdim4.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
vedaTavafAdim4.vedaDuaArap: Allāhumma lā tajʿal hādhā ākhir al-ʿahdi min baytika l-ḥarāmi wa min hādhā l-makāni l-mubārak
vedaTavafAdim4.vedaDuaMeaning: O Allah! Do not make this the last of my visit to Your Sacred House and this blessed place.
vedaTavafAdim4.multezemDuaArap: Allāhumma innī ʿabduka wa-bnu ʿabdika wa-bnu amatika, ḥamaltu ʿalā raqabatī, wa-nufidha fī-ya ḥukmuka
vedaTavafAdim4.multezemDuaMeaning: O Allah! I am Your servant, the son of Your servant and the son of Your maidservant. I have borne the burden on my neck; Your decree has been decreed for me.
vedaTavafAdim4.note1: 📍 If possible, supplicate at al-Multazam before the door of the Kaʿbah.
vedaTavafAdim4.note2: 😢 Do not hold back your tears; this is the most sincere moment of supplication.
vedaTavafAdim4.note3: 🤲 Supplicate for yourself, your parents, and all your loved ones.
vedaTavafAdim4.note4: 🕌 Gaze at the Kaʿbah one last time; imprint this moment on your heart.
vedaTavafAdim4.note5: 💚 May Allah accept; may your Ḥajj be blessed. 🤲

vedaTavafAdim5.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
vedaTavafAdim5.cikarkenDuaMeaning: O Allah! I ask You of Your favour (grace).
vedaTavafAdim5.ayrilisDuaArap: Allāhumma lā taqṭaʿ ʿannī barakata hādhā l-makāni wa lā taḥrima min ʿawdatihi
vedaTavafAdim5.ayrilisDuaMeaning: O Allah! Do not cut off for me the blessing of this place, and do not deprive me of returning to it.
vedaTavafAdim5.note1: 🚪 Step out with the left foot; you may back out while facing the Kaʿbah.
vedaTavafAdim5.note2: 👀 As you pass through the door, look at the Kaʿbah one last time.
vedaTavafAdim5.note3: 😢 If you have tears, that is a beautiful farewell.
vedaTavafAdim5.note4: 🤲 May your Ḥajj be accepted; may Allah bring you here again.
vedaTavafAdim5.note5: 🎉 Congratulations! You have completed the Ḥajj. 🕌

arafatVakfesiAdimlar.step1: 1. Step: After sunrise, travel to ʿArafāt
arafatVakfesiAdimlar.step2: 2. Step: Perform ghusl before the time of the sun at its zenith (before ẓuhr)
arafatVakfesiAdimlar.step3: 3. Step: Perform Ẓuhr and ʿAṣr in combined (jamʿ) form — jamʿ al-taqdīm
arafatVakfesiAdimlar.step4: 4. Step: Stand in waqf toward the qiblah, in supplication and dhikr
arafatVakfesiAdimlar.step5: 5. Step: After each prayer, recite the takbīr of tashrīq
arafatVakfesiAdimlar.step6: 6. Step: When the sun has set, travel to Muzdalifah; do not leave (ʿArafāt) early

arafatVakfesiAdim1Hareket.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
arafatVakfesiAdim1Hareket.dua: Allāhumma ilayka tawajjahtu wa bika iʿtaṣamtu fa-thabbitnī bi al-ḥabli alladhī lā yanfaṣim
arafatVakfesiAdim1Hareket.meaning: O Allah! I turn to You and hold fast to You. Bind me with the unfailing bond (cable that never breaks).
arafatVakfesiAdim1Hareket.talbiyeNote: The talbiyah is continued on the way to ʿArafāt.
arafatVakfesiAdim1Hareket.note1: 📅 9 dhū al-Ḥijjah — the Day of ʿArafah: leave after sunrise.
arafatVakfesiAdim1Hareket.note2: 📍 ʿArafāt is about 25 km south-east of Makkah.
arafatVakfesiAdim1Hareket.note3: ⚠️ The time of the waqf (standing) is from the sun’s zenith to sunset on this day.
arafatVakfesiAdim1Hareket.note4: 🏔️ It is especially virtuous to be near Jabal al-Raḥmah (the Mount of Mercy) for the waqf.
arafatVakfesiAdim1Hareket.note5: 🤲 This is the greatest pillar of Ḥajj — be present with your whole heart.

arafatVakfesiAdim2Gusl.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
arafatVakfesiAdim2Gusl.niyet: I intend to perform ghusl. O Allah, purify me from my sins.
arafatVakfesiAdim2Gusl.g2: 2️⃣ Wash the hands up to the wrists
arafatVakfesiAdim2Gusl.g5: 5️⃣ Pour water over the head three times, wetting the hair thoroughly
arafatVakfesiAdim2Gusl.g6: 6️⃣ Wash the rest of the body, starting on the right shoulder, then the left
arafatVakfesiAdim2Gusl.note1: ⏰ It is done before the time of the sun at its zenith (before the ḍuhr period).
arafatVakfesiAdim2Gusl.note2: 🤍 This ghusl symbolises purification before the waqf (standing at ʿArafah).
arafatVakfesiAdim2Gusl.note3: 💧 If a full ghusl is not possible, wuḍūʾ (ritual ablution) is enough.
arafatVakfesiAdim2Gusl.note4: ✨ As you purify the body, turn the heart to Allah and seek forgiveness of sins.

arafatVakfesiAdim3Namaz.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
arafatVakfesiAdim3Namaz.sequenceTitle: How the prayers are performed (in order):
arafatVakfesiAdim3Namaz.s1: 1️⃣ The adhān of Ẓuhr is called
arafatVakfesiAdim3Namaz.s2: 2️⃣ The regular sunnah of Ẓuhr is offered
arafatVakfesiAdim3Namaz.s3: 3️⃣ With iqāmah, the fard of Ẓuhr (2 rakʿahs, qaṣr) is prayed
arafatVakfesiAdim3Namaz.s4: 4️⃣ Then iqāmah and the fard of ʿAṣr (2 rakʿahs, qaṣr) — jamʿ with taqdīm
arafatVakfesiAdim3Namaz.warning: ⚠️ No sunnah between the two fard, and the adhān is not called between them
arafatVakfesiAdim3Namaz.note1: 🕌 The two prayers are combined in advance ((jamʿ) al-taqdīm) at ʿArafah.
arafatVakfesiAdim3Namaz.note2: 📍 In congregation, ideally at Masjid Namirah if possible; it may be prayed in the tent.
arafatVakfesiAdim3Namaz.note3: 🤲 Begin the waqf (standing) right after the prayer; do not spend this time in vain.

arafatVakfesiAdim4Vakf.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
arafatVakfesiAdim4Vakf.bestTitle: The most virtuous supplication at ʿArafah:
arafatVakfesiAdim4Vakf.bestDua: Lā ilāha illallāh waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahu al-mulku wa lahu al-ḥamdu wa huwa ʿalā kulli shay'in qadīr
arafatVakfesiAdim4Vakf.bestMeaning: There is no god but Allah, alone, without partner. To Him belongs the kingdom, to Him is all praise, and He is over all things Omnipotent.
arafatVakfesiAdim4Vakf.vakfeDua: Allāhumma innaka tasmau kalāmī wa tarā makanī wa ta'lamu sirrī wa 'alānīyatī, lā yakhfa' alayka shay'un min amrī
arafatVakfesiAdim4Vakf.vakfeMeaning: O Allah! You hear my words, You see my place, You know my inward and my outward. Nothing of my state is hidden from You.
arafatVakfesiAdim4Vakf.note1: 🕌 One stands turned toward the qiblah, with the hands raised.
arafatVakfesiAdim4Vakf.note2: 😢 Sincere weeping, humility, and repentance are among the greatest acts of this moment.
arafatVakfesiAdim4Vakf.note3: 🤲 Supplicate for yourself, your parents, and all the believers.
arafatVakfesiAdim4Vakf.note4: ⏰ The waqf is from the sun’s zenith to sunset of this day.
arafatVakfesiAdim4Vakf.note5: 🏔️ The Prophet (ﷺ) said: “Ḥajj is ʿArafah” (the standing here is the great pillar of Ḥajj).

arafatVakfesiAdim5Tesrik.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
arafatVakfesiAdim5Tesrik.title: Takbīr of al-tashrīq (the tashrīq formula):
arafatVakfesiAdim5Tesrik.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ وَلِلَّهِ الْحَمْدُ
arafatVakfesiAdim5Tesrik.translit: Allāhu Akbar, Allāhu Akbar, lā ilāha illallāh wa Allāhu Akbar, Allāhu Akbar wa lillāhi al-ḥamd
arafatVakfesiAdim5Tesrik.meaning: Allāh is the Greatest, Allāh is the Greatest. There is no god but Allāh, and Allāh is the Greatest, Allāh is the Greatest. To Allāh belongs all praise.
arafatVakfesiAdim5Tesrik.note1: 📅 It begins from the Fajr of the Day of ʿArafah (ʿArafah morning).
arafatVakfesiAdim5Tesrik.note2: 📅 It continues until the ʿAṣr of the fourth day of ʿEid (al-tashrīq days).
arafatVakfesiAdim5Tesrik.note3: 🕌 After each fard, once after the salām — one full recitation of the formula.
arafatVakfesiAdim5Tesrik.note4: 👩 Women recite quietly, without raising the voice.
arafatVakfesiAdim5Tesrik.note5: 🔢 It follows the 23 fard ṣalāh of this period (once after each of those fard, as counted in common teaching).

arafatVakfesiAdim6Muzdelife.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
arafatVakfesiAdim6Muzdelife.dua: Allāhumma bika āmantu wa ʿalayka tawakkaltu wa ilayka anabtu wa bika ḥāṣamtu wa anta Rabbī
arafatVakfesiAdim6Muzdelife.meaning: O Allah! In You I have believed, on You I have relied, to You I have turned, with You I seek strength, and You are my Lord.
arafatVakfesiAdim6Muzdelife.note1: ⏰ Travel begins only after the sun has fully set; early departure (before ʿArafah is over) is not valid for the waqf.
arafatVakfesiAdim6Muzdelife.note2: ⚠️ Having been in ʿArafah by day and leaving before sunset makes a expiation (dam by sacrifice) required in the classical ruling.
arafatVakfesiAdim6Muzdelife.note3: 🚌 On the way, engage in talbiyah, takbīr, and supplication.
arafatVakfesiAdim6Muzdelife.note4: 🌙 Maghrib and ʿIshāʾ are offered together (jamʿ) at Muzdalifah; they are not performed on the road.
arafatVakfesiAdim6Muzdelife.note5: 📍 Muzdalifah is between ʿArafāt and Minā, roughly 9 km.

muzdelifeVakfesiAdimlar.title: WAQF AT MUZDALIFAH
muzdelifeVakfesiAdimlar.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
muzdelifeVakfesiAdimlar.step1: 1. Step: Perform Maghrib and ʿIshāʾ in combination (jamʿ) — jamʿ al-taʾkhīr
muzdelifeVakfesiAdimlar.step2: 2. Step: Spend the night at Muzdalifah and perform the waqf (obligatory)
muzdelifeVakfesiAdimlar.step3: 3. Step: Spend the night in dhikr, supplication, and istighfār
muzdelifeVakfesiAdimlar.step4: 4. Step: Gather 49 or 70 small pebbles for stoning
muzdelifeVakfesiAdimlar.step5: 5. Step: Perform Fajr and the post-dawn waqf supplication
muzdelifeVakfesiAdimlar.step6: 6. Step: Travel to Minā before sunrise

muzdelifeVakfesiAdim1.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim1.s2: 2️⃣ With iqāmah, Maghrib obligatory is performed first (3 rakʿahs)
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim1.s3: 3️⃣ Without the sunnah, iqāmah is given again
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim1.s4: 4️⃣ The ʿIshāʾ obligatory is performed (2 rakʿahs — qasr)
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim1.s5: 5️⃣ The ʿIshāʾ sunnah and witr are performed
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim1.note1: ⏰ Maghrib is not offered on the road; it is combined with ʿIshāʾ at Muzdalifah.
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim1.note2: 🕌 This prayer is called jamʿ al-taʾkhīr (combination with delay).
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim1.note3: ⚠️ Sunnah is not performed between the two obligatories; the adhān is not repeated.
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim1.note4: 📍 If possible, perform it near the Mashʿar al-Ḥarām.
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim1.note5: 👩 Women perform it in the same way.

muzdelifeVakfesiAdim2.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim2.dua: Allāhumma kamā waffaqtanā lil-wuqūfi fī hādhihi l-mashāʿiri l-ḥarāmi fawaffiqnā liziyāʿati baytik
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim2.meaning: O Allah! As You have enabled us to perform waqf in this blessed place, enable us to visit Your House (the Bayt) as well.
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim2.note1: 📍 In Muzdalifah, the entire area is valid for waqf except the Wādī Muhassir (Valley of Muhassir).
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim2.note2: ⏰ The obligatory waqf time is between true dawn and sunrise.
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim2.note3: 😴 Sleeping does not nullify the waqf; being present in Muzdalifah is sufficient.
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim2.note4: 🤲 If possible, perform waqf near al-Mashʿar al-Ḥarām (the Sacred Monument).
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim2.note5: ⚠️ Leaving Muzdalifah without a valid excuse requires a sacrificial expiation (dam).
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim2.note6: 🌙 The elderly, the sick, and the weak may proceed to Minā after midnight when needed.

muzdelifeVakfesiAdim3.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim3.istighfarMeaning: I ask Allah for forgiveness and I turn to Him in repentance.
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim3.tavsiyeDua: Allāhummaghfir lī wa li-wālidayya wa lil-muʾminīna wa l-muʾmināt
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim3.tavsiyeMeaning: O Allah! Forgive me, my parents, and all believing men and women.
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim3.note1: 🌙 The supplications made this night are especially precious.
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim3.note2: 📖 Recite the Qurʾān; verses of istighfār in particular.
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim3.note3: 😴 Rest is worship too; tomorrow in Minā will be a demanding day.

muzdelifeVakfesiAdim4.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim4.tasSayi1: 1️⃣ 1st day of ʿĪd → 7 pebbles at the Large Jamrah
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim4.tasSayi2: 2️⃣ 2nd day of ʿĪd → 21 pebbles for the 3 jamarāt (7+7+7)
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim4.tasSayi3: 3️⃣ 3rd day of ʿĪd → 21 pebbles for the 3 jamarāt (7+7+7)
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim4.tasToplam70: 🔢 Total: 70 pebbles (for those staying 4 days — Nefr-i Sani, the additional day of stay)
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim4.ozelliklerTitle: What the pebbles should be like:
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim4.ozellik2: ✅ Clean is best; a soiled pebble can still be thrown if needed
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim4.ozellik3: ❌ Do not use large stones, clods of earth, or mud
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim4.ozellik4: 📍 Collecting them at Muzdalifah is sunnah; they may be taken from elsewhere too
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim4.note1: 🌙 They are collected before or after the morning prayer.
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim4.note2: 👜 Keep them in a small bag.
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim4.note3: ⚠️ Pebbles that have already been thrown are not collected again.

muzdelifeVakfesiAdim5.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim5.sabahNotu1: ⏰ Perform Fajr as soon as its time begins; do not delay without need.
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim5.sabahNotu2: 🕌 It is the last ṣalāh you pray at Muzdalifah.
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim5.vakfeDua: Allāhumma bika uṣal wa-ilayka uwaljīʾu wa-bika aḥtamil
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim5.vakfeMeaning: O Allah! I call upon You, I turn to You, and I take my resort in You.
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim5.mesharDua: Allāhumma kamā ʾallamtanā mashāʾlaka fa-qdhnā fī ziyāratik
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim5.mesharMeaning: O Allah! As You have taught us Your rites, accept us in (this) visit to You as well.
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim5.note1: 🌅 After the prayer, remain in supplication and dhikr until the place is well lit by daylight.
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim5.note2: 📍 If you can, perform the waqf near al-Mashʿar al-Ḥarām.
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim5.note3: ⏰ Head toward Minā before the sun rises.
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim5.note4: 🤲 Make the most of these last moments; a busy day in Minā lies ahead.

muzdelifeVakfesiAdim6.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim6.yolaCikisDua: Allāhumma ilayka tawajjahtu wa-bika ʿtazamtu fa-ghfir lī wa-ḥabbib ilayya liqāʾak
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim6.yolaCikisMeaning: O Allah! I have turned to You, and I have held fast to You. Forgive me, and make my meeting with You dear to me.
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim6.telbiyeNote: Continue the talbiyah on the way to Minā.
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim6.note1: ⏰ Travel before sunrise, not after the sun has risen.
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim6.note2: 🌙 The elderly, the ill, and the weak may set out early after midnight if needed.
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim6.note3: 📍 Pass through Wādī Muhassir quickly; do not stop there.
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim6.note4: 🔢 The first rite in Minā is to throw 7 pebbles at the Large Jamrah.
muzdelifeVakfesiAdim6.note5: 🎉 Today is the 1st day of ʿĪd — a very full and very moving day.

ihramAdimlar.title: Our steps
ihramAdimlar.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
ihramAdimlar.step1: 1. Step: Complete the required body cleaning.
ihramAdimlar.step3: 3. Step: Put on the Ihram clothing.
ihramAdimlar.step4: 4. Step: Pray 2 rak'ahs of the Ihram prayer.
ihramAdimlar.step7: 7. Step: Learn and observe the Ihram prohibitions

minaGecelemeAdimlar.step1: 1. Step: Go to Minā (8 dhū al-Ḥijjah, after sunrise)
minaGecelemeAdimlar.step2: 2. Step: Perform Ẓuhr, ʿAṣr, Maghrib, ʿIshāʾ, and Fajr in Minā (two rakʿahs each; not combined [jamʿ])
minaGecelemeAdimlar.step3: 3. Step: Pass the night in worship with dhikr, supplication, and recitation of the Qurʾān
minaGecelemeAdimlar.step4: 4. Step: Remain the night in Minā (a confirmed sunnah)

minaGecelemeAdim1Hareket.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
minaGecelemeAdim1Hareket.dua: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
minaGecelemeAdim1Hareket.meaning: In the name of Allah I place my trust in Allah; there is no might nor power except with Allah.
minaGecelemeAdim1Hareket.talbiye: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لَا شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ
minaGecelemeAdim1Hareket.talbiyeNote: The talbiyah is continued on the way to Minā.
minaGecelemeAdim1Hareket.note1: 📅 On the morning of 8 dhū al-Ḥijjah, one departs after sunrise.
minaGecelemeAdim1Hareket.note2: 📍 Minā lies in a valley between Makkah and ʿArafāt.
minaGecelemeAdim1Hareket.note3: 🚶 Walking is sunnah; going by vehicle is also permitted.
minaGecelemeAdim1Hareket.note4: ⏰ One stays in Minā until the Fajr of the Day of ʿArafah.
minaGecelemeAdim1Hareket.note5: 🕌 Those performing tamattuʿ enter ihram again for Hajj on this day.

minaGecelemeAdim2Namaz.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
minaGecelemeAdim2Namaz.important1: 🕌 In Minā, prayers are performed in shortened (qaṣr) form.
minaGecelemeAdim2Namaz.important2: That is, the four-rakʿah prayers are offered as two rakʿahs.
minaGecelemeAdim2Namaz.important3: But each prayer is at its own time; prayers are not combined (jamʿ).
minaGecelemeAdim2Namaz.note1: ⏰ Each prayer is on time; it is not brought forward or delayed beyond its time.
minaGecelemeAdim2Namaz.note2: 🤲 Between prayers, occupy yourself with dhikr, supplication, and the talbiyah.
minaGecelemeAdim2Namaz.note3: 📍 If possible, pray at Masjid al-Khayf; praying in the tent is also valid.

minaGecelemeAdim3Gece.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
minaGecelemeAdim3Gece.zikir4: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ — 1 time
minaGecelemeAdim3Gece.nightDua: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ رَحْمَتَكَ وَمَغْفِرَتَكَ وَرِضْوَاكَ وَالْجَنَّةَ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ سَخَطِكَ وَعُقُوبَتِكَ وَمِنَ النَّارِ
minaGecelemeAdim3Gece.meaning: O Allah! I ask You for Your mercy, Your forgiveness, Your good pleasure, and Paradise. I seek refuge in You from Your anger, Your punishment, and from the Fire.
minaGecelemeAdim3Gece.note1: 📖 Recite the Qurʾān; it is especially virtuous to recite Sūrah al-Baqarah and Āl ʿImrān.
minaGecelemeAdim3Gece.note2: 🤲 The supplications of this night are very precious; supplicate with sincerity.
minaGecelemeAdim3Gece.note3: 🌙 Tomorrow is the standing at ʿArafāt — the greatest moment approaches.
minaGecelemeAdim3Gece.note4: 😴 Rest is also an act of devotion; sleep to be strong for the day ahead.

minaGecelemeAdim4Mina.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
minaGecelemeAdim4Mina.importance1: The Prophet (ﷺ) spent the night in Minā and made this a sunnah.
minaGecelemeAdim4Mina.importance2: This is the night of preparation for the great moment at ʿArafāt.
minaGecelemeAdim4Mina.nightDua: Allāhumma bika aṣbaḥnā wa bika amsaynā wa bika naḥyā wa bika namūtu wa ilayka al-maṣīr
minaGecelemeAdim4Mina.meaning: O Allah! By You we enter the morning and the evening, by You we live and die, and to You is the return.
minaGecelemeAdim4Mina.note1: 📍 You must pass the night within the boundaries of Minā; do not go outside them.
minaGecelemeAdim4Mina.note2: 🌙 Tomorrow is 9 dhū al-Ḥijjah — the Day of ʿArafah, the greatest pillar of Ḥajj.
minaGecelemeAdim4Mina.note3: 😴 Rest well: a long and blessed day awaits you tomorrow.
minaGecelemeAdim4Mina.note4: 🤲 Before sleep, supplicate and give thanks to Allah.

kudumAdimlar.step1: 1. Step: Recite the supplication for entering al-Masjid al-Ḥarām
kudumAdimlar.step2: 2. Step: Greet the Black Stone (Ḥajar al-Aswad) and intend the ṭawāf
kudumAdimlar.step3: 3. Step: Perform seven circuits of ṭawāf around the Kaʿbah
kudumAdimlar.step4: 4. Step: Greet the Yemeni Corner (Rukn al-Yamanī) each circuit
kudumAdimlar.step5: 5. Step: Perform two rakʿas of ṭawāf prayer at Maqām Ibrāhīm

kudumAdim1Mescid.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
kudumAdim1Mescid.dua: Allāhumma anta al-salām wa minka al-salām, fa hayyinā Rabbanā bi al-salām
kudumAdim1Mescid.meaning: O Allah! You are As-Salām, and safety is from You. Keep us alive, our Lord, in safety (salvation).
kudumAdim1Mescid.note: 📍 Enter with the right foot at the gate of al-Masjid al-Ḥarām and recite this supplication.

kudumAdim2Hacerulesved.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
kudumAdim2Hacerulesved.niyet: I intend to perform ṭawāf — O Allah, accept it from me.
kudumAdim2Hacerulesved.meaning: In the name of Allah — Allah is the Greatest.
kudumAdim2Hacerulesved.note1: 📍 The Black Stone is at the eastern corner of the Kaʿbah.
kudumAdim2Hacerulesved.note2: 🤲 If possible it is kissed; if crowded, greet it from a distance by raising the hand.
kudumAdim2Hacerulesved.note3: ⚠️ Do it without harming anyone; no pushing or forcing.
kudumAdim2Hacerulesved.note4: 🔄 At each circuit, when you reach the Black Stone, greet it again.

kudumAdim3Tavaf7.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
kudumAdim3Tavaf7.dua: Subḥān Allāhi wa al-ḥamdu lillāhi wa lā ilāha illallāhu wallāhu akbar
kudumAdim3Tavaf7.yemaniHacerLabel: Between the Yemeni Corner and the Black Stone:
kudumAdim3Tavaf7.yemaniHacer: Rabbanā ātinā fī al-dunyā ḥasanah wa fī al-ākhirati ḥasanah wa qinā ʿadhāb al-nār
kudumAdim3Tavaf7.note1: 🔄 Ṭawāf begins at the Black Stone, with the Kaʿbah on your left.
kudumAdim3Tavaf7.note2: 🕋 Walk outside the Ḥāṭim; do not go through the inside (the semi-circle).
kudumAdim3Tavaf7.note3: 🚶 Men perform ramal (brisk, shoulder-rolling walk) in the first three rounds.
kudumAdim3Tavaf7.note4: 👆 In each round, touch the Yemeni Corner, and salute the Black Stone.
kudumAdim3Tavaf7.note5: 🚫 Do not recite the talbiyah while performing ṭawāf.
kudumAdim3Tavaf7.note6: 👩 Women do not raise their voices, and it is good to do ṭawāf in a less crowded area if possible.

kudumAdim4RuknYemani.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
kudumAdim4RuknYemani.betweenLabel: Supplication between the Yemeni Corner and the Black Stone:
kudumAdim4RuknYemani.betweenArabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
kudumAdim4RuknYemani.betweenLatin: Rabbanā ātinā fī al-dunyā ḥasanah wa fī al-ākhirati ḥasanah wa qinā ʿadhāb al-nār
kudumAdim4RuknYemani.betweenMeaning: Our Lord! Give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and save us from the punishment of the Fire.
kudumAdim4RuknYemani.note1: 📍 Rukn al-Yamanī is at the south-western corner of the Kaʿbah.
kudumAdim4RuknYemani.note2: 🤲 If possible, greet with the hand; it is not kissed.
kudumAdim4RuknYemani.note3: ↔️ Greeting from a distance is enough; you do not have to push or strain.

kudumAdim5MakamIbrahim.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
kudumAdim5MakamIbrahim.ayetLabel: Verse to reflect on before the prayer:
kudumAdim5MakamIbrahim.ayetMeaning: And take, [O believers], from the standing place of Ibrāhīm a place of prayer. (Qurʾan 2:125)
kudumAdim5MakamIbrahim.note1: 📍 If possible, pray behind Maqām Ibrāhīm.
kudumAdim5MakamIbrahim.note2: 👥 If crowded, the prayer may be offered anywhere in al-Masjid al-Ḥarām.
kudumAdim5MakamIbrahim.note3: ⏰ It is not performed at the disliked (karāhah) times.
kudumAdim5MakamIbrahim.note4: 🤲 After the prayer, face the Kaʿbah and supplicate.

kudumAdim6Zemzem.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
kudumAdim6Zemzem.whileArabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا وَاسِعًا وَشِفَاءً مِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ
kudumAdim6Zemzem.whileLatin: Allāhumma innī as'aluka ʿilman nāfiʿan wa rizqan wāsiʿan wa shifā'an min kulli dā'
kudumAdim6Zemzem.whileMeaning: O Allah! I ask You for beneficial knowledge, ample provision, and healing from every disease.
kudumAdim6Zemzem.note1: 🕋 It is recommended standing, facing the Kaʿbah.
kudumAdim6Zemzem.note2: 💧 Drink plenty, but do not waste.
kudumAdim6Zemzem.note3: 🤲 Afterwards one makes a personal supplication; this is a very precious time.
kudumAdim6Zemzem.note4: ✨ It is authentically reported that Zamzam is for whatever intention it is drunk for (hadith).

sayAdimlar.step1: 1. Step: Go up to Safa and form the intention for saʿy
sayAdimlar.step2: 2. Step: Face the Kaʿbah, say the takbīr, tahlīl, and supplicate
sayAdimlar.step3: 3. Step: Walk from Safa toward Marwah (men may walk briskly at the green lights)
sayAdimlar.step4: 4. Step: At Marwah, turn toward the Kaʿbah and say the takbīr and supplicate
sayAdimlar.step5: 5. Step: Continue until 7 rounds are complete (4 outward + 3 return legs)
sayAdimlar.step6: 6. Step: At Marwah, complete the supplication as appropriate

sayAdim1Safa.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
sayAdim1Safa.ayetArabic: إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ
sayAdim1Safa.ayetMeaning: Indeed, Ṣafā and Marwah are among the symbols of Allah. (Qurʾan 2:158)
sayAdim1Safa.niyet: O Allah! I intend to perform saʿy for Your sake. Make it easy for me and accept it from me.
sayAdim1Safa.note1: 📍 Saʿy begins at Ṣafā and ends at Marwah.
sayAdim1Safa.note2: 🕋 Open the hands, say the takbīr and tahlīl, while facing the Kaʿbah.
sayAdim1Safa.note3: 🔢 One round (shaṭṭ) is Ṣafā → Marwah; the next is Marwah → Ṣafā.
sayAdim1Safa.note4: 🏃 Men may run (harwalah) in the marked section; women walk normally.

sayAdim2Tekbir.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
sayAdim2Tekbir.tekbir: Allāhu Akbar, Allāhu Akbar, Allāhu Akbar
sayAdim2Tekbir.tehlil: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah, lahu al-mulku wa lahu al-ḥamdu wa huwa ʿalā kulli shay'in qadīr
sayAdim2Tekbir.tehlilMeaning: There is no god but Allah, alone, without partner. His is the dominion and His is the praise, and He has power over all things.
sayAdim2Tekbir.dua: Allāhumma innaka qulta wa daʿawnī fastajibtu lakum, wa innaka lā tukhliful-mīʿād
sayAdim2Tekbir.duaMeaning: O Allah! You said ‘Call upon Me, I will answer you’ — and You do not break Your promise.
sayAdim2Tekbir.note1: 🕋 Facing the Kaʿbah, open the hands to shoulder level.
sayAdim2Tekbir.note2: 🔄 This supplication is done at Ṣafā and on each turn at Marwah.
sayAdim2Tekbir.note3: 👩 Women recite quietly without raising the voice.

sayAdim3SafaMerve.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
sayAdim3SafaMerve.dua: Rabb ighfir warḥam wa-tajāwaz ʿammā taʿlamu innaka anta l-aʿazzu l-akram
sayAdim3SafaMerve.duaMeaning: My Lord! Forgive, have mercy, and pardon what You know. Surely You are the Most Mighty, the Most Generous.
sayAdim3SafaMerve.note1: 🚶 While walking, one keeps busy with takbīr, tahlīl, and supplication.
sayAdim3SafaMerve.note2: 🏃 Men run with ramal in the green-lit area between the markers.
sayAdim3SafaMerve.note3: 👩 Women walk normally, even in the green-lit area; they do not run.
sayAdim3SafaMerve.note4: 📏 The distance between Ṣafā and Marwah is about 400 metres.
sayAdim3SafaMerve.note5: ➡️ From Ṣafā to Marwah is the first leg (al-shaṭṭ al-awwal).

sayAdim4Merve.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
sayAdim4Merve.tekbirLine: Allāhu Akbar, Allāhu Akbar, Allāhu Akbar
sayAdim4Merve.tehlilLine: Lā ilāha illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lah
sayAdim4Merve.dua: Allāhumma innaka qulta udʿūnī astajib lakum, wa innaka lā tukhliful-mīʿād
sayAdim4Merve.duaMeaning: O Allah! You said, ‘Call upon Me, I will answer you’ — and You do not break Your promise.
sayAdim4Merve.note1: 📍 The same supplications as at Ṣafā are repeated at Marwah.
sayAdim4Merve.note2: 🔄 When finished at Marwah, one returns toward Ṣafā.
sayAdim4Merve.note3: 🔢 Each arrival at Marwah completes one leg (shaṭṭ).
sayAdim4Merve.note4: 7️⃣ The seventh leg ends at Marwah; saʿy is completed there.
sayAdim4Merve.note5: 👩 Women do not raise their voices.

sayAdim5YediSavt.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
sayAdim5YediSavt.note1: 🔢 Saʿy always starts at Ṣafā and ends at Marwah.
sayAdim5YediSavt.note2: 🏃 Men do harwalah in the green‑lit area on each leg.
sayAdim5YediSavt.note3: 🤲 At each hill, one turns toward the Kaʿbah and supplicates.
sayAdim5YediSavt.note4: ⚠️ If the leg count is uncertain, the lower count is taken.
sayAdim5YediSavt.note5: 💺 You may rest when tired; saʿy may be completed in more than one session.

sayAdim6MerveSonDua.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
sayAdim6MerveSonDua.bitirisDua: Allāhumma taqabbal minnā innaka Anta as-Samīʿu al-ʿAlīm
sayAdim6MerveSonDua.bitirisMeaning: O Allah! Accept this from us; You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.
sayAdim6MerveSonDua.vedaDua: Rabbanā ātinā fī ad-dunyā ḥasanatan wa fī al-ākhirati ḥasanatan wa qinā ʿadhāb an-nār
sayAdim6MerveSonDua.vedaMeaning: Our Lord! Grant us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the Fire.
sayAdim6MerveSonDua.note1: ✅ The seventh leg is completed at Marwah; saʿy ends here.

ihramAdim1Temizlik.male3: Trim hair and beard, shorten the mustache
ihramAdim1Temizlik.male4: Use pleasant scent (forbidden after entering Ihram)
ihramAdim1Temizlik.female3: Do not use makeup or perfume (forbidden in Ihram)
ihramAdim1Temizlik.female4: If menstruating, ghusl is still taken; you may do all rites except tawaf

ihramAdim2Gusl.line4: Take water in the mouth, rinse
ihramAdim2Gusl.line6: Wash the whole body (no dry spot left)
ihramAdim2Gusl.line7: Let water reach the roots of the hair

ihramAdim3Elbise.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
ihramAdim3Elbise.male2: One lower garment: the izar is worn wrapped from the waist down.
ihramAdim3Elbise.male3: The other: the rida is draped over the shoulders.
ihramAdim3Elbise.male5: On the feet: sandals or open footwear at the heels.
ihramAdim3Elbise.female1: Normal, clean, and modest clothes are worn.
ihramAdim3Elbise.female2: The dress should not show the body’s shape.
ihramAdim3Elbise.female4: The face and hands remain visible.
ihramAdim3Elbise.female5: Ornate accessories, perfume, and eye-catching dress are avoided.

ihramAdim4Namaz.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
ihramAdim4Namaz.line1: Face the qibla in a state of wudūʾ
ihramAdim4Namaz.line2: Intention: “I intend to perform the Ihram prayer”
ihramAdim4Namaz.line4: In the first rak'ah: al-Fātiḥah and al-Kāfirūn,
ihramAdim4Namaz.line5: in the second: al-Fātiḥah and al-Ikhlāṣ (recommended)

ihramAdim5Niyet.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
ihramAdim5Niyet.line1: O Allah! I intend to perform the Hajj for Your good pleasure. Make it easy for me and accept it from me.
ihramAdim5Niyet.line2: The intention is made in the heart; saying it aloud is sunnah.

ihramAdim6Telbiye.backA11y: Go back to the previous screen
ihramAdim6Telbiye.reading: Labbayk Allāhumma labbayk, labbayk lā sharīka laka labbayk, inna l-ḥamda wa n-niʿmata laka wa l-mulk, lā sharīka lak.
ihramAdim6Telbiye.meaning: Here I am, O Allah, here I am; here I am, You have no partner, here I am. All praise, grace, and the kingdom are Yours; You have no partner.

acilDurum.banner: In a real emergency, call 911 or 999 first. Always stay in contact with your camp officials.

info.lostBody: Approach staff at the gates of Al-Masjid Al-Haram. Show your camp number and group badge. Stay calm and do not wander away from the crowds.
info.healthBody: Mobile health units are available in Mecca, Medina, and Mina. Call 911 for fainting or cardiac events. For heatstroke: move to shade, drink water, and get to an air-conditioned area.
info.documentBody: Immediately contact your camp manager and your country's consulate. Keep passport copies in a separate pocket. Your consulate can issue a temporary travel document.
info.crowdBody: Without panicking, lean against a wall or fixed structure. Move with the flow of the crowd. Never try to move against the current, and do not bend down to pick up fallen items.
